entries.zh: §S《乌托邦》§!扩展包添加了新的机制，让你可以更精细地控制自己的帝国，并建造巨型结构。
entries.en: The §SUtopia§! expansion allows for finer control of your empire, and enables the building of Megastructures.

entries.zh: 我们推荐§S《乌托邦》§!，因为该帝国的特质符合其中解锁的全新帝国类型：蜂巢思维。
entries.en: We're recommending §SUtopia§! as the makeup of this empire suits its new empire type, the Hive Mind.

entries.zh: 我们推荐§S《乌托邦》§!，因为该帝国的特质适合其中解锁的关于统一或管理人口的机制和内容。
entries.en: We're recommending §SUtopia§! as the makeup of this empire suits its mechanics and content, centered on unifying or policing one's population.

entries.zh: 我们推荐§SUtopia§!，因为该帝国的特质与其人口管理和劳动力优化的机制和内容吻合。
entries.en: We're recommending §SUtopia§! as the makeup of this empire complements its its population control and workforce optimization mechanics.

entries.zh: 这个巨型结构的拥有者是§Y$OWNER$§!。
通过战略性超频，此巨型结构可超出标准操作极限，解锁独特效果。
entries.en: Through strategic overclocking, this megastructure may exceed standard operational limits and unlock unique effects.

entries.zh: §R你并非该巨型结构的拥有者。§!
entries.en: §RYou are not the owner of this Megastructure.§!

entries.zh: 一个§Y$pc_ringworld_habitable$§!容纳了数个行星大小的区块，但需要拆除星系中其他的行星天体作为材料。
entries.en: A §Y$pc_ringworld_habitable$§! allows for multiple planet-like zones, cannibalizing all other planets in the system for materials.

entries.zh: 一个完整的环形世界包含了４个修建完成的环形世界区段，每一段都相当于一个巨大的盖亚星球。
entries.en: A full Ring World consists of 4 Completed Ring World Sections, each equivalent to a massive Gaia world.

entries.zh: 这个设施将作为集结地、资源仓库，并为成千上万的环形世界建设者提供居住区。
entries.en: This complex will serve as a staging ground, resource depot and living quarters for the hundreds of thousands of personnel involved in the Ring World's construction.

entries.zh: 这个初期的框架结构环绕着星系内的恒星，并会作为我们最后建设完整宜居带的平台。
entries.en: This initial skeletal frame encircles the system's sun, and serves as the platform on which we will eventually build fully habitable sections.

entries.zh: 这个框架结构大体上构成了未完成的环形世界的总表面区域的四分之一。其中较小型的宜居区块的建设工作还没有完成。
entries.en: This skeletal frame section makes up roughly one quarter of the unfinished Ring World's total surface area. Work on the smaller habitable section has not yet been completed.

entries.zh: 已完成的环形世界区段
一个功能完整的环形世界区段、包含了一个可供居住的活跃生态圈。
entries.en: A fully functional habitable Ring World section, complete with an active biosphere, that is ready for settlement.

entries.zh: §Y$think_tank_3$§!的研究实验室和数据库能够产出源源不断的原生数据流。
entries.en: The research labs and databanks of a §Y$think_tank_3$§! generate an immense flow of raw, undiluted science.

entries.zh: 这个初步的基址将会担任起未来科学枢纽的建设基础。
entries.en: This initial site will serve as the base for the future construction of a Science Nexus.

entries.zh: 中央核心配备有最先进的奇点电站，能够满足科学枢纽的所有能量需求。日后它也将与新建的研究设施相连通。
entries.en: Equipped with a state of the art singularity reactor, the central core will cover most of the Nexus' energy needs. It will also connect the future research facilities.

entries.zh: 科学枢纽研发辅翼包含绝大部分的实验室并为科学家们提供住所。分支配备了多个安保区域，在必要时可以完成对不同区域的封锁。
entries.en: The research wings will contain most of the labs and provide housing for the scientists. They come with multiple security chambers to allow for complete lockdown of various areas, if necessary.

entries.zh: 一个设备齐全且随时可以投入使用的科学枢纽。
entries.en: A fully equipped and operational Science Nexus.

entries.zh: 以它的创造者的名字命名，这个科学枢纽的驱动核心结合着一个装有我们最优秀的科研人员的大脑的神经库，这使得它能够加速运转。
entries.en: Named after its inventor, this Science Nexus has a neural bank containing the brain of one of our finest researchers integrated into its main drive, allowing it to operate at an increased speed.

entries.zh: 我们帝国拥有的§H居住站§!会获得额外的§Y2§!个区划。
entries.en: §HHabitats§! owned by our Empire have space for an additional §Y2§! districts.

entries.zh: 一个 §Y$dyson_sphere_5$§!完全的包裹住一个特定的恒星，直接将恒星辐射输出转化为£energy£ 能量币。
entries.en: A §Y$dyson_sphere_5$§! fully envelops a given star, converting all solar output directly to £energy£ Energy Credits.

entries.zh: §R$dyson_sphere_5$会完全遮挡住恒星，导致恒星系中所有行星变成荒芜星球或冰冻星球。\n\n恒星系中的一切环境改造候选将无法再进行改造。§!
entries.en: §RA $dyson_sphere_5$ will blot out the sun, turning all planets in the system into Barren or Frozen Worlds.\n\nAny Terraforming Candidates in the system will be ruined.§!

entries.zh: 此施工场地可用作未来建造戴森球的基址。
entries.en: The construction site station serves as the base for the future construction of a Dyson Sphere.

entries.zh: 这个是未来戴森球的框架基础，还不会生产任何能量。
entries.en: The frame is the foundation for the future Dyson Sphere and does not generate any energy.

entries.zh: 部分运作中的戴森球——能量生产效率§Y25%§!。
entries.en: A partially operational Dyson Sphere - §Y25%§! energy generation efficiency.

entries.zh: 部分运作中的戴森球——能量生产效率§Y50%§!。
entries.en: A partially operational Dyson Sphere - §Y50%§! energy generation efficiency.

entries.zh: 部分运作中的戴森球——能量生产效率§Y75%§!。
entries.en: A partially operational Dyson Sphere - §Y75%§! energy generation efficiency.

entries.zh: 完全运作中的戴森球——能量生产效率§G100%§!。
entries.en: A fully operational Dyson Sphere - §G100%§! energy generation efficiency.

§R$TRIGGER_FAIL$Cannot colonize due to the ongoing §Y$dyson_sphere_5$§! construction§!

entries.zh: 随着工程的不断推进，§Y$spy_orb_4$§!会逐步的扩展探测范围，最终将囊括整个星系。
entries.en: The stages of the §Y$spy_orb_4$§! gradually expand sensor range, eventually covering the entire galaxy.

entries.zh: 随着工程的不断推进，$spy_orb_4$会逐步的扩展探测范围，最终将囊括整个星系。
entries.en: The stages of the $spy_orb_4$ gradually expand sensor range, eventually covering the entire galaxy.

entries.zh: 这个建筑平台空间站将作为未来装配哨兵阵列的基础。
entries.en: The construction station serves as the base for the future assembly of a Sentry Array.

entries.zh: 一个配有专职天文学家和战术分析师的最先进的监听哨站。
entries.en: A state-of-the-art listening post crewed by a permanent staff of astronomers and tactical analysts.

entries.zh: 沿中央尖顶安装的振荡鳍能将微弱的信号从无处不在的背景辐射中分辨出来。
entries.en: Oscillating fins arranged along a central spire isolate faint signals from ever-pervasive background radiation.

entries.zh: 巨大的静态天线将覆盖范围提升到了史无前例的范围。
entries.en: Massive, static antennas provide an unprecedented boost to raw coverage.

entries.zh: 完整的哨兵阵列能够将探测范围延伸至整个星系。
entries.en: A complete Sentry Array extends sensor range to cover the entire galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们[Root.GetRulerTitle]举国都对[From.GetSpeciesName]怀有轻蔑之感。说实话一看到你就让我的[Root.GetSpeciesOrganName]不舒服。
entries.en: The contempt our [Root.GetRulerTitle] feels towards you is shared by our entire nation, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Indeed, my [Root.GetSpeciesOrganName] churns at the mere sight of you.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]，就凭你们混乱而松散的社会，任何的成就都无法取得。你们这种文化不可能诞生出一位如同我们[Root.GetRulerTitle]一样伟大的领袖。
entries.en: How little you must accomplish in your chaotic, unstructured society, [From.GetSpeciesName]. I suppose it is foolish to believe a culture such as yours could ever produce a great leader like our [Root.GetRulerTitle].

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]，你给[Root.GetRulerTitle]留下了深刻的印象。你们现在是[Root.GetName]的朋友了。
entries.en: You have made quite an impression on the [Root.GetRulerTitle], [From.GetSpeciesName]. You are friends of the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: §E我们追求真正的平等——别挡道。§!
entries.en: §EWe pursue true equality - do not stand in our way.§!

entries.zh: §E你们这些卑微的存在并不会威胁到我们[Root.GetRulerTitle]。§!

entries.en: §E[Root.GetRulerName] speaks on behalf of the [Root.GetAdj] people.§!

entries.zh: 开始一场宗教复兴，这将使帝国思潮向§Y唯心主义§!转变。
entries.en: Start a religious renaissance, shifting empire ethics towards §YSpiritualist§!.

entries.zh: 在调查完§Y[From.GetStarName]§!星系巨大的环形世界之后，科学专员 §Y[Root.GetLeaderName]§!汇报称除去年代久远之外，它和我们自己的环形世界的设计结构很相似。\n\n只有一个关键的区别——这个环形世界的区段在部分架构上采用了我们所未知的新型资源。初步报告描述着东西是某种“活体金属”。不管怎么样，这需要更为严密的研究。
entries.en: After surveying the immense ring world found in the §Y[From.GetStarName]§! system, Science Officer §Y[Root.GetLeaderName]§! has reported that it is similar in many ways to our own ring designs, despite its age.\n\nThere is one critical difference, however - the ring sections appear to have been constructed partly out of a new resource that is unknown to us. Initial reports describe it as some kind of "living metal." Whatever it is, it should be studied more closely.

entries.zh:
我们的殖民船缓慢的降落在覆盖着§Y[Root.GetName]§!广阔的草原上。这里的大气略微干燥但同样怡人，在确定着陆点的过程中也观察到一大群温顺的食草动物。

舰船已被改造成新居住地的行政基地，它的反应堆核心正在被拆除来用作殖民地的暂时能量来源。

数百个小帐篷和简易房环绕着星舰巨大的船体，殖民者开始大片大片地登陆——在这外星世界上的第一座[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]之城。
entries.en:
Our colony ship has gently touched down on the sprawling savanna that covers most of §Y[Root.GetName]§!. The shimmering air is dry yet pleasant, and a large herd of docile herbivores can be seen observing from a distance as our first landing site is established.

The ship has been permanently converted into the administrative headquarters of the new settlement, and its reactor core is in the process of being removed so that it may serve as the colony's temporary power source.

Hundreds of small tents and prefab shelters have sprung up around the former starship's massive hull as colonists begin to disembark in large numbers - the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

entries.zh:
我们的舰船想方设法，以惊人且优雅的姿态在§Y[Root.GetName]§!上无数锯齿状的山峰中回旋，并成功降落在一个遮蔽山谷中的理想着陆点。

舰船已被改造成新居住地的行政基地，它的反应堆核心正在被拆除来用作殖民地的暂时能量来源。

数百个小帐篷和简易房环绕着星舰巨大的船体，殖民者开始大片大片地登陆——在这外星世界上的第一座[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]之城。
entries.en:
Our colony ship managed, with surprising grace, to maneuver between the massive peaks that are so prevalent in the jagged landscape of §Y[Root.GetName]§!. It touched down in a sheltered valley that will serve as an ideal first landing site.

The ship has been permanently converted into the administrative headquarters of the new settlement, and its reactor core is in the process of being removed so that it may serve as the colony's temporary power source.

Hundreds of small tents and prefab shelters have sprung up around the former starship's massive hull as colonists begin to disembark in large numbers - the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

entries.zh: §L最近的演习活动激发了公众对舰队兴趣。很多民众踊跃报名入伍，意味着我们可以花费更少的资源来为星舰补充人手。§!
entries.en: §LThe recent naval drills have spurred a great deal of interest in the fleet among the public. We have no shortage of new recruits, which means that we will have to spend less resources to find crews for our starships.§!

entries.zh: §L我们最近的大规模舰队演习使得我们的船员训练有素，能够让舰只保持更高的射速。§!
entries.en: §LAs a result of the large fleet maneuvers we recently held, our well-trained naval crews are able to maintain a higher rate of fire.§!

entries.zh: §L我们的舰队中大部分领导层因为我们最近取消了计划内的舰队演习而感到不满。他们认为这是一种难以忍受的懦弱表现并且确信我们的邻国会利用这点。§!
entries.en: §LLarge segments of our military leadership are disgruntled due to the recent cancellation of our planned fleet maneuvers. They feel that it is an unacceptable sign of weakness that our neighbors are sure to take advantage of.§!

entries.zh: §L我们军队中大部分人都对于我们未能在外交上对最近发生在我们边境附近的大规模外国舰队演习进行抗议而大发雷霆。§!
entries.en: §LA large segment of our military is furious over the fact that we failed to diplomatically object to the massive foreign fleet exercise that recently took place close to our borders.§!

entries.zh: 当有更有效率的东西出现时，一味坚持陈旧、衰老的东西是一个愚蠢的决定。\n\n我们现有的科技水平使得神经植入体能够应用于我们[Root.GetName]的全体国民。我们的公民在四肢和器官被改良型的机械版本替换之后，将会变得更强、更快、更聪明。
entries.en: It is a fool who persists in clinging to a worn, decrepit instrument when a more efficient alternative presents itself.\n\nWe now possess the technology to make cybernetic implants available to the population of the [Root.GetName] at large. Our citizens will be stronger, faster and more intelligent as limbs and organs are replaced with improved mechanical versions.

entries.zh: 是时候抛弃我们有缺陷的器官和血管并且拥抱不朽了。我们必须为我们的所有人口准备先进的合成替身，然后开始意识传输过程。
entries.en: It is time to leave our flawed organic vessels behind and embrace immortality. We must prepare advanced synthetic avatars for our entire population, and then begin the process of consciousness transfers.

entries.zh: 来自该物种的领袖有额外特质
entries.en: Leaders from this species have additional traits

entries.zh: §L这个物种已经接受了义体化，他们物种的绝大多数成员都变成了义体人。他们会定期用更为先进的机械版本代替他们的有机身体组织。§!\n
entries.en: §LThis species has embraced cybernetics on such a scale that its members may be considered cyborgs. They routinely replace their organic body parts with more advanced mechanical versions.§!\n

entries.zh: 将§Y50%§!的$food_with_icon$（或等效资源）维护费替换为$energy_with_icon$维护费\n$t$—$MOD_POP_BONUS_WORKFORCE_MULT$：§G+10%§!
entries.en: Replaces §Y50%§! of $food_with_icon$ (or equivalent) Upkeep with $energy_with_icon$ Upkeep\n$t$- $MOD_POP_BONUS_WORKFORCE_MULT$: §G+10%§!

entries.zh: §L这个物种有潜在的灵能天赋，不过这个天赋还在大部分的成员体内潜伏。虽然非常难得，但是这个能力会在部分领袖身上体现。§!\n
entries.en: §LThis species has latent psionic abilities, which are dormant in most of its members. Although quite rare, these powers will manifest in some leaders.§!\n

entries.zh: §L要是给义体人装上电钻，那什么都看起来像矿。§!
entries.en: §LOutfit a cyborg with a battery of power drills, and suddenly everything looks like a mineral deposit.§!

entries.zh: §L从营养疗法，就地平衡技术到单杆脱粒技术，这一整套技术工具能够增加义体人劳工的食物产出。§!
entries.en: §LA suite of tools, from nutrient solution diagnostics and on-site balancing to per-stalk micro-threshing, enables cybernetic workers to increase produce yields.§!

entries.zh: §L超导性材料在单元设计中的应用将能源传输过程中的损耗降低至百分之零。§!
entries.en: §LThe use of superconductive materials in units have cut energy transmission losses to zero percent.§!

entries.zh: §L这些极其高效的处理器有助于提高工作强度和持久度。§!
entries.en: §LThese highly efficient processors increase the both workload and endurance.§!

entries.zh: §L驾驭愈发复杂的科学前沿研究需要并行处理器以增强有机大脑。§!
entries.en: §LEfficiently navigating the increasingly complex frontiers of science requires parallel processors to augment organic brains.§!

entries.zh: §L忠诚该概念只属于有机生物。但用简单的程序服从则会更加高效。§!\n
entries.en: §LLoyalty as an ideal is a distinctly organic concept. It is much more efficient to simply program compliance.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这些可折叠的劳工单位有着灵活的关节，这使他们能在运输过程中整齐地折叠成一堆，然后在现场自行组装。§!\n
entries.en: §LCollapsible labor units with flexible joints enable them to fold neatly into stacks during transportation, then self-assemble on site.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这些高度先进的超级机器并不是为装在箱子里遨游宇宙而设计的。§!\n
entries.en: §LThese highly advanced mega-machines were not designed to traverse the universe in a box.§!\n

entries.zh: §L所有自动单位都配备了一种应用了革命性的、新的磁感应技术的存储单元，极大地强化了他们的性能。§!\n
entries.en: §LA revolutionary technique fits autonomous units with memory cells using a revolutionary, new technique for magnetic induction, improving their performance significantly.§!\n

entries.zh: §L拥有镀铬钛合金制成的防护外骨骼，这些重型机器专为严酷环境而设计，只需要极少的维护。§!\n
entries.en: §LProtected by exoskeletons of chrome-plated titanium, these heavy-duty machines were designed to excel under harsh conditions and require less maintenance.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这些机器的设计完全没有考虑到使用年限的问题，因此故障频发。它们经常需要进行维护。§!\n
entries.en: §LThese machines were designed with a complete disregard for longevity and are prone to malfunction. They will require frequent maintenance.§!\n

entries.zh: §L复杂的自我学习算法，能够模拟单元神经丛的快速演化。§!\n
entries.en: §LSophisticated, self-learning algorithms that stimulate the rapid evolution of a unit's neural clusters.§!\n

entries.zh: §L通过限制劳工的认知能力我们就能促使他们专注于简单的任务。§!\n
entries.en: §LBy limiting the cognitive abilities of our workers we can encourage them to focus on more menial tasks.§!\n

entries.zh: §L每一个新单元都以前所未有地追求细节精心制作。这是一个工程和艺术的奇迹，但缺乏效率。§!\n
entries.en: §LEach new unit is crafted with unparalleled attention to detail. A marvel of engineering and art, but not very efficient.§!\n

entries.zh: §L单元生产过程被优化为尽可能节约成本，使用回收的原料，以及从上一世代继承下来的部件。§!\n
entries.en: §LUnit manufacturing has been optimized to be as cost-effective as possible, using recycled materials, and components inherited from previous generations.§!\n

entries.zh: §L高度批次化的AI处理使这些单位得以在极大规模的集群行动时只有最小的效率损失。§!
entries.en: §LExtensively batched AI processes allow these units to scale greatly with minimal loss of efficiency.§!

entries.zh: §L每个个体单位均会发送和接收大量的重复数据，使得各中央处理单元附属的单位数量增加时带来的延迟指数增长。§!
entries.en: §LIndividual units send and receive a vast amount of largely duplicate data, causing exponential lag as the number of units attached to each central processing hub increases.§!

entries.zh: §L预测算法可以实现最大的优化。市场上无穷小的波动，无论是流通率、库存情况、有机客户的情绪反应都会被纳入考量。§!
entries.en: §LPredictive algorithms allow for maximum optimization. Infinitesimal market fluctuations in currency rates, stock availability, and the emotional response of organic partners are accounted for.§!

entries.zh: §L这些义体部件需要频繁地从外接电源充电。§!
entries.en: §LThese cybernetic components require frequent recharging from an external power source.§!

entries.zh: §L这个亚种的个体自发地对自我的基因序列进行了改造，以期为他们自己带来某种形式上的优势。§!
entries.en: §LMembers of this offshoot species have spontaneously altered their genetic makeup to give themselves an advantage.§!

entries.zh: 来自虚境的强大灵能力量减缓了该[GetLeaderLoc]的自然[GetAgingLoc]进程。
entries.en: The powerful psionic energies of the Shroud have slowed the natural [GetAgingLoc] process of this [GetLeaderLoc].

entries.zh: 这位领袖是位改革家，致力于建设美好的明日社会。
entries.en: This leader is a reformer, dedicated towards building the society of tomorrow.

entries.zh: 这位领袖是构成[owner.GetGestaltEntityName]庞大认知系统的不朽的纽带。
entries.en: This leader is the immortal nexus of the vast cognitive apparatus that constitutes a [owner.GetGestaltEntityName].

entries.zh: 飞升天赋是一个特殊的强力加成，可以由我们的帝国完成传统树来解锁。
entries.en: Ascension Perks are special bonuses that our empire can unlock by completing a tradition tree.
Are you sure you want to select $KEY|H$?

entries.zh: §G点击来查看可用的飞升天赋列表§!
entries.en: §GClick to view the list of available Ascension Perks§!

entries.zh: 通过采纳一个传统组内的所有传统或研究飞升理论科技来解锁一个飞升天赋。
entries.en: Finish a Tradition group by adopting all its Traditions or research the Ascension Theory technology to unlock an Ascension Perk.

entries.zh: 显示所有的飞升天赋，即使有些我们尚未满足要求。
entries.en: Show all Ascension Perks, even if we don't currently fulfill all requirements.

entries.zh: 一个废弃的戴森球。尽管它已经年久失修，但这个庞然大物的基本结构大部分完好无损。通过必要的科技和大量的资源投入，我们就有可能修复好这个戴森球。
entries.en: A ruined Dyson Sphere. Despite its age, the megastructure's basic frame is largely intact. With the necessary technology and vast amounts of resources, the sphere could potentially be repaired.

entries.zh: 一个废弃的科学枢纽。尽管它的内部已经被掠夺者抢夺一空，但这个庞然大物的主体大部分都保持完好。运用适当的科技并投入大量资源，我们应该能够让它重新工作。
entries.en: A ruined Science Nexus. Although its insides were stripped clean by looters eons ago, the megastructure's main hull is still mostly intact. With the right technology and a lot of resources, it could potentially be refurbished.

entries.zh: 这个破碎的残骸曾是一个无比强大的哨兵阵列。尽管已经老化，它的主体大部分都保持完好。运用适当的科技和大量的资源，我们就有可能让它重新工作。
entries.en: The shattered remnants of what was once an extremely powerful Sentry Array. Despite its age, the megastructure's antennas are, for the most part, structurally intact. With the right technology and a large amount of resources, the array could potentially be restored to working order.

entries.zh: 这个环形世界区段曾容纳过一个功能齐全的居住地，但现在已经废弃。在理论它修复还可以被修复，但这需要更先进的科技和大量的资源。
entries.en: This section of the Ring World once supported a functional biosphere, but no longer. Repairs are theoretically feasible, but it would require advanced technology and a large amount of resources.

entries.zh: 我们在[dyson_system.GetName]星系遇到了一个巨型结构的残骸，包围着这个恒星系的恒星。我们的科学家初步判断这曾是个“§H戴森球§!”——一个用于彻底利用恒星能量的巨型结构。它显然已经无法继续运转，这是由于它的主体遭受到了来自未知的能量武器的致命打击。\n\n$utopia.2010.c.desc$
entries.en: We have encountered the remains of an enormous space structure in [dyson_system.GetName], encompassing the system's primary. Our scientists theorize that this may have once been a functional "§HDyson Sphere§!" - a megastructure designed to harness the power of a star. It is obviously no longer operational, with its hull having sustained critical damage from an unknown type of energy weapon.\n\n$utopia.2010.c.desc$

entries.zh: 我们在[dyson_system.GetName]星系遇到了一个戴森球的残骸。它显然已经无法继续运转，这是由于它的主体遭受了未知的能量武器的致命打击\n\n$utopia.2010.c.desc$
entries.en: We have encountered the remains of a Dyson Sphere in the [dyson_system.GetName] system. It is obviously no longer operational, with its hull having sustained critical damage from an unknown type of energy weapon.\n\n$utopia.2010.c.desc$

entries.zh: 值得注意的是这个戴森球残骸周围同时也漂浮着许多舰船残骸。这个戴森球的本体很古老，但其周围的残骸云明显来自于更近的年代。这些残骸似乎大多来自两支舰队之间的一场激烈交战，这场战斗很可能因为争夺这个废弃戴森球的归属权而爆发。
entries.en: Of note are also the large debris fields surrounding the sphere. Although the megastructure itself is ancient, much of the debris in the system appears to be significantly younger. Most of it seems to originate from two distinct battle fleets that pummeled each other into oblivion, possibly in a war to decide ownership over the shattered sphere at some point in more recent galactic history.

entries.zh: 它看起来与我们自己的戴森球功能相近。
entries.en: It appears functionally similar to our own sphere.

entries.zh: 我们成功修复了位于[From.GetName]星系内的废弃戴森球。星系内庞大的碎片云被收集起来用于修复工程，这样既减少了我们资源的消耗，又为工作人员消除了一个潜在的航行风险。\n\n这个巨型结构现已恢复正常运作，在沉寂了千百年后再次产出巨额的能源。
entries.en: We have successfully repaired the ruined Dyson Sphere in the [From.GetName] system. The large debris fields present in the system were gathered for use in the repair effort, reducing both material costs and removing a potential navigational hazard for the work crews.\n\nThe great megastructure is now fully operational, generating vast amounts of energy again for the first time in eons.

entries.zh: 我们在[nexus_system.GetName]发现了一座巨大太空装置的残骸。该巨型结构似乎曾是一个巨大的§H科学枢纽§!。尽管其已废弃数千年，但其主体结构依然完好。
entries.en: The broken remnants of a colossal space installation have been found near the [nexus_system.GetName]. This megastructure appears to have once served as some kind of massive §HScience Nexus§!. Although the installation has obviously been abandoned for millennia, its hull is still reasonably intact.

entries.zh: 它看起来与我们的科学枢纽具有相近的功能。
entries.en: The concept appears similar to our own Science Nexus.

entries.zh: 在[From.GetName]附近的废弃科学枢纽已被完全修复了，并配备了[Root.GetName]的精英科学家。这个巨型结构仍然保持着设计师当初建造它时的初衷，在这个时代继续帮助我们解决更多的科学问题。
entries.en: The abandoned Science Nexus near [From.GetName] has been fully repaired and staffed by the brightest minds of the [Root.GetName]. As was no doubt its original purpose, the megastructure will now be put to use in answering the scientific questions of our time.

entries.zh: 在星系历史上的某个时间点，[sentry_system.GetName]星系曾建有过一个体积异常巨大的轨道设施，后来被有组织地拆毁。此星系大部分天体的行星同步轨道上都弥漫着大量的残骸，当中不乏大型空间站的外壳。\n\n残骸中以一个庞大的§H哨兵阵列§!为最。经过我们初步的扫描结果推测，这个阵列强大到足以实时监控整个星系。
entries.en: At some point in galactic history, the [sentry_system.GetName] system evidently supported a vast orbital infrastructure of unusual proportions which has since been systematically demolished. There are large concentrations of debris in geostationary orbits around most of the planetary bodies in this system, including several massive space station hulks.\n\nThe largest of these is a colossal §HSentry Array§!. Our initial scans suggest that when it was operational, this array was powerful enough to provide real-time sensor coverage over the entire galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们已经有哨兵阵列了。
entries.en: We already have one of those.

entries.zh: 虽然十分困难，我们的工程师还是设法修复了位于[From.GetName]恒星系的废弃哨兵阵列，并在过程中回收利用了散布在周围的空间站残骸。\n\n时隔亿万年，哨兵阵列在轰鸣中再次投入运作，列阵之中能量充盈，借助它强力的信号，整个星系一览无余。
entries.en: It wasn't easy, but our engineers have managed to restore the ruined Sentry Array in the [From.GetName] system. The other station hulks and the debris that surrounded them were converted into building material during the restoration effort.\n\nFor the first time in eons, the array now hums with energy. Its powerful antennas can once again see clear to the other side of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 这些环绕着[ring_system.GetName]星系中央恒星的残骸，来自一个古老的环形世界。任何曾经存在于这个恒星系的行星体，都在这个庞然大物的修建工程中被作为建筑材料而使用。\n\n没有证据能够指明这个工程奇迹最初是被谁修建的，但这一定是一个高度先进文明的杰作。
entries.en: The shattered remnants of an ancient Ring World encircle the star of the [ring_system.GetName] system. Any planetary bodies that may once have existed here must have been used as building material during this megastructure's construction.\n\nNo evidence hinting towards who originally built this marvel of engineering has been found, but it must have been the product of a very advanced culture.

entries.zh: 至少他们和我们的文明一样先进。
entries.en: As advanced as we are, at any rate.

entries.zh: 基于[From.GetName]星系的环形世界废墟，我们的工程师成功地将它的一个区段恢复运转。全新的环形世界生态结构几乎是由我们的行星学家从零开始规划，但现在它已经足够稳定，可以居住了。
entries.en: Building on what remains of the ruined Ring World in the [From.GetName] system, our engineers have managed to fully restore one of its sections. The new biosphere had to be created more or less from scratch by our leading planetologists, but it is now considered stable and ready for habitation.

entries.zh: 对[From.GetName]的表面细致勘探后我们发现了一个巨大撞击坑，其中散步着一些来历不明的古代舰船残骸碎片。这些舰船中似乎完全没有装配生命支持系统，我们推测它们可能是一些巨型无人机或者由某种人工智能操控。\n\n这些舰船的船体材料颇为有趣，是由§H活性金属§!这种极其稀有的无机材料构造而成。这种材料属性多样而独特，可以被“编码”成特定形状，在受到损伤时，能够缓慢地自我修复。数千年过去，舰船上的活性金属逐渐熔化，形成了巨大、致密的矿脉，可供我们采集数个世纪。
entries.en: Detailed surface scans of [From.GetName] have identified a large impact crater containing the wreckage of several ancient starships of unknown design. The ships appear to be completely devoid of life support systems, leading us to suspect that they were either unusually large drones or controlled by some form of artificial intelligence.\n\nInterestingly, the hull of the ships was constructed out of §HLiving Metal§!, an exceedingly rare and inorganic material with many unique properties. This metal can be "programmed" to assume a certain shape or form, and it will slowly regrow itself if damaged. Over a period of several millennia, the surviving metal from the wrecked ships was fused into a large and extremely dense deposit that could potentially be mined for centuries to come.

entries.zh: 我们发现了一个巨大的撞击坑，这似乎不是自然形成的。
entries.en: A large impact crater has been discovered that does not seem to be a natural occurrence.

entries.zh: 我们失去了[Root.GetName]殖民地！这些来自异次元的侵略者先是摧毁了轨道空间站，而后对着星球表面狂轰滥炸，收割了地表上的所有生命。[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的整个生物圈都被毁灭殆尽——连一点生命的痕迹都没有了。
entries.en: We have lost our colony on [Root.GetName]! After taking up positions in orbit, the extradimensional invaders bombarded the surface and feasted on all life forms below. The [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s entire biosphere was consumed by the creatures - not a single trace of anything living remains.

entries.zh: 我们已经修建了第一个轨道居住站，该准备一艘殖民船，着陆在我们亲手创造的世界上了。\n\n从机械核心到山麓之巅，居住站的一砖一瓦都经过精心设计，俨然成为了我们浩瀚星海中的新家园。
entries.en: We have completed the construction of our first habitat and it is finally time to ready a colony vessel and make landfall on a world we ourselves have created.\n\nFrom its mechanized core to its highest mountains, every nut, bolt, creek and cranny has been designed to fit our needs perfectly in our new home among the stars.

entries.zh: [From.From.From.Planet.GetName]轨道居住站已经修建完成，可以殖民了。
entries.en: The [From.From.From.Planet.GetName] habitat is now complete and ready for colonization.
